# CONSTRUCTED INPUT, NOT A CAPTURE. No EC was read to make this file; every
# byte below was written by hand. See ../README.md.
# Shape: `ecrw.py dump 0x0400 0x0060` as §3's step 6 takes it, for the a0
# block's after dump. It differs from the before dump at the three addresses the
# 0x0400-0x045F capture records moving -- 0x0402, 0x043E and 0x044F -- and at
# no other, so the whole-block read over this pair is exactly the set that
# capture shows. Every value is invented. Not a prediction that a die warms
# like this, or that it does not.
